seo.description: ISI marked high pressure seamless steel gas cylinders as per IS:7285. Sizes 5-50 Ltrs, 150-300 Bar. Supplied from Nagpur.

about: Gas cylinders are seamless steel (or aluminium) pressure vessels fitted with a valve whose outlet thread depends on the gas — fuel gases typically use left-hand threads and oxidisers right-hand, so fittings are not interchangeable. Choose capacity by how long you want a cylinder to last at your flow rate.
Cylinders must be pressure-tested at regular intervals; check the test date stamped on the shoulder before filling or use. Ask us about sizes, valve types and cylinder exchange.
